services.desc: Upcycled featured works made by artists who repurpose commonplace, discarded, or unexpected materials to make detailed and surprising works of art. In this VanGo exhibition, featured artist Victoria Fuller’s work examines the connections between humanity and nature. Each piece illuminates a different aspect of the relationship between those two forces, which Fuller describes as, “a delicate balance”. The VanGo has been inhabited by an army of imaginary organisms. Scientists believe they have escaped from the dreams of three artists. It’s time to investigate! services.desc: Located in Midtown Harrisburg at Third and Calder Streets, just blocks from the State Capitol, SAM offers two distinct, state-of-the-art spaces for rent at reasonable rates. You and your guests can celebrate the arts in one of Central Pennsylvania’s most inspirational settings and the only dedicated art museum in Harrisburg. SAM’s Venue Rental spaces are typically available beginning at 5 pm. Earlier hours may be available based upon museum programming. Some days are excluded due to our exhibition schedule. 50% of the total rental fee including the damage deposit and a signed rental agreement are required in order to reserve a venue rental.
